A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M97). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

These tests fail when the machine is loaded and pass alone. None is relic code: `TestTasksRemoteTasksOnlyBoardOnTheOldPlaceIsRepointedWithWhatItSaved`, `TestTasksRemoteBoardInATasksOnlyFolderAndACodeCloneShareTasksBothWays` (a ref lock race between two fetches) and the `internal/webui` browser tests.

## Wanted

Find the cause of each. Start with the first, run on `main` with `-count=20`.

## Done when

- Each test has a recorded cause.
- Each passes 20 times in a row beside a second full test run.

Two more were seen on 2026-11-26 during a 26-minute loaded run of `internal/cli`, and pass alone: `TestCompactCLIDefersPublicationToALiveWatcher` and `TestWatcherStaysTrustworthyWithACompactedOnOriginTask` (both "watcher never completed a synchronization").
